spec_match.rationale: Probes every form derivable from the propdef grammar none | [ [ before | after ] || [ links | tabs ] ] (curl-verified against the live css-overflow-5 draft, including the valdef anchors) plus four invalid controls, and the exact-surface check is CSS.supports('scroll-marker-group', value) — nothing broader.

interactive.rationale: Live 15-row matrix with re-run button, a free-form value tester, and a serialization inspector that sets a declaration on a real element and reads back both the declaration block and getComputedStyle.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises a grammar matrix with invalid controls and a serialization inspector, which is exactly what the page renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Invalid controls (after nav, before after, links tabs, none tabs), empty-input guards on both testers, and the rejected-declaration branch of the serialization inspector all render distinct honest outcomes; the classify() summary can and does report partial support on Chromium 141.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5109685301673984, the propdef anchor, the sibling concepts, and the feature overview.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the same contracts the page probes: a passing-today baseline, each mode pair, the bare and order-free || forms (honestly failing on 141), a computed-value round-trip, and a must-reject negative control.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37: matrix reports 11/15 agreeing with the draft grammar (bare links/tabs and reversed order rejected), serialization inspector shows after → 'after links', 'tabs before' → stored nothing / computed stays 'none'; desktop screenshot read, 360×740 DPR3 emulation shows scrollWidth 360 with no horizontal overflow, console has zero errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js is loaded deferred and showcaseTelemetry?.assert records the matrix run (with the after-tabs/bare-tabs split), each free-form probe, and each serialization read.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables, page-local buttons set background and color together, verdict/ok/bad pairs are the emerald/rose-on-paper combinations used across the site, and the wide table scrolls inside its own overflow-x container.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons and labelled text inputs (44px min targets), table with caption and row/column th scope, aria-live on the verdict and both outputs, visible focus from the shared stylesheet; all controls driven by keyboard in verification.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280×2200 (screenshot read) and CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 touch: no horizontal document overflow (scrollWidth 360), the matrix table scrolls within its own container, inputs and buttons are full-width-friendly and ≥44px.

openQuestions.title: Re-measure the matrix on a Chrome 154 build and record the full-grammar screenshot
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the page correctly reports partial mode grammar (11/15 agreement). Once a 154 or flag-enabled Canary build is available in the verification environment, re-run the matrix and confirm the bare (links/tabs) and order-free (tabs before) rows flip to accepted and classify() reports the full grammar; attach the evidence to this critique.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible tablist roving tabindex arrow key keyboard interaction
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption and th scope, label every control natively, and prefer native elements over ARIA.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Matrix uses caption + th scope=col/row, both testers use explicitly associated labels, and all controls are native button/input elements.

guidanceConsulted.query: CSS carousel scroll markers accessible tabs pattern
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Derive carousel active-state styling from browser state (scroll-state/:target-current) rather than JS scroll listeners.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Informed the framing that the grammar page probes parser state only and leaves visual active-state demonstration to the carousel concept, which uses :target-current.

summary: Grammar coverage is exact and honest: every || expansion from the live draft plus invalid controls, measured through CSS.supports with a serialization inspector that surfaces the mode-aware 'after → after links' computed value. On the Chromium 141 verification build the page truthfully reports the partial state (pairs parse, bare/reversed forms do not) with clean console and no 360px overflow.
